summary: No forecasts have resolved yet; nothing to reveal.
how_to_check: For each forecast, SHA-256 over the JSON of {question, outcomes, resolves_on, filed_on} must equal fingerprint_sha256 AND the line for that id in commitments-ledger.jsonl, whose first_published must be on or before resolves_on. node build/verify-commitment.js revealed.json commitments-ledger.jsonl does exactly this.
limitations: Brier score: 0 is perfect, 0.5 is a coin flip on a two-way question, 2 is the worst possible. Lower is better.
A matching commitment proves the text was fixed before the answer was known; it says nothing about whether the question was well chosen.
Scores are only as honest as the resolution — outcomes are entered by hand from the sources named in each question.
